turns.text: Lloyd, my 3D printer bed isn't leveling right. Any quick fixes before I call support?
Try cleaning the bed with isopropyl alcohol first. If that fails, check the Z-offset in the firmware settings. It’s often just a calibration drift.

Tried that, no dice. Anyway, I'm going deep into the RT-X paper notes today. It's wild how BridgeData V2 and Open X-Embodiment form the training backbone for robot foundation models like RT-1, RT-2, RT-X, Octo, OpenVLA, and Pi0.
That standardization has been crucial for cross-embodiment transfer. Have you checked the data mixing ratios they used?
Yeah, mostly equal weight. Hey, did that hardware order for the new GPU arrive? I need to run some local inference tests.
I can check the tracking status. Last update was 'Out for Delivery' this morning. Should be at your door by 2 PM.
Perfect. I'll set up the environment once it lands. Lunch plans? Still doing that taco place?
Yes, El Taco Loco at 1:30. Don't be late, the line gets long.
